name: JW39 (Hubble)
blurb: JW39, a jellyfish galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: jw39-hubble
story: Drifting through the hot gas of a galaxy cluster, this galaxy is having its own gas swept back into long trailing ribbons. New stars are being born in those tendrils, much as they are in the galaxy's disk.

claims.text: It lies in a galaxy cluster; ram-pressure stripping pulls gas into trailing ribbons of star formation
Star formation in the tentacles is not noticeably different from the disk
